ensemble_recommendation: Build the house BTC CMA as a layered ensemble, not a single engine, because no method honestly produces the decade level. (1) LEVEL/SHAPE anchor: take the central 8-12% nominal from the cross-method decay consensus, mechanically shaped by the power-law/age decay (id 4) and cross-checked by cycle-amplitude decay (id 68) and the debasement-CAGR floor (id 31) as a bound — trim id 4's high central level down to the honest band. (2) MACRO/REGIME conditioning of the drift sign: global-liquidity direction (id 25) as the one robust replicated BTC-macro overlay, with FTPL (id 26) as a fiscal-dominance scenario lever. (3) VOLATILITY cell: HAR-RV/GARCH (id 42) for the ~57% floor, cross-checked by rough-vol (id 21). (4) CORRELATION row: DCC+copula (id 48) for the time-varying +0.56 equity / ~0 gold structure, cross-checked by the GPR safe-haven test (id 55) and factor regression (id 9). (5) TAILS: EVT (id 47) for VaR/ES plus the regime-switching/jump process (id 18) for the body fat-tails, the survival/absorbing-zero hazard (id 19) to make the -100% point-mass explicit, and LPPLS (id 17) for within-cycle crash-hazard. (6) RECONCILIATION: feed all of these as coherent views into Entropy-Pooling (id 71) under the rational-bubble identity E[r]=discount+crash-hazard (id 51) so the final return/vol/correlation/tail panel is internally consistent and non-normal. Use the LTCMA tuple (id 15) and barbell (id 30) only as external sanity brackets, never as the engine. The mutually-orthogonal core to actually combine: 4, 25, 42, 48, 47, 18, 19, 71.
signal_notes: Signal map for a 10-15yr BTC CMA. Realized facts the ensemble must reproduce: appreciation decays 142->65->17%/yr (full/10y/5y), so the DECAY ANCHOR dominates and any method implying a flat/rising high return (S2F id 0 at ~78%/yr) is disqualified as an engine. Vol floor ~57%; equity correlation RISES to +0.56 in the ETF era; BTC-gold correlation ~0. Honest central output: ~8-12% nominal / 5-9% real, vol ~50-60%, gold corr ~0-0.15. KEY STRUCTURAL TRUTH: because the level is a near-consensus decay anchor, a method's marginal value is the CONDITIONING it adds — tails, regime, correlation — NOT its level forecast. That is why the top of the ranking is dominated by risk-shape and dependence engines (18, 47, 48) and regime overlays (25, 51), while the most-cited 'valuation' families (S2F 0, rainbow 69, Metcalfe 1, NVT 2, cost-floor 3) sit at the bottom: they are spurious non-stationary co-trends (price-on-time or price-on-price) that broke post-2021 and add no tail/correlation/regime information. Three failure modes recur and should be treated as automatic downgrades: (a) spurious I(1) regression / cointegration that fails (0,1,2,6,24,67,69); (b) circularity where the 'driver' is endogenous to price (cost/energy 3,35; on-chain 8,65; flow-elasticity 67; demographics 56); (c) horizon mismatch — clean short-tenor risk machinery (options 10,37,38; ML 41; carry 39) extrapolated to a decade. Orthogonality is the scarce resource: the genuinely independent information blocks are the liquidity-direction macro factor (25), the higher-moment/tail engine (18/47), the dependence structure (48), the absorbing-zero hazard (19), the policy/flight conditioning (53/54), and the reconciliation layer (71/51). Everything in the scarcity, adoption, and monetary-TAM clusters is largely redundant with the shared decay anchor plus one liquidity beta, so include at most one representative from each as a cross-check. Net: combine ~8 orthogonal lenses, let the decay anchor set the level, and spend the modeling effort on the risk shape and correlation row where the methods actually differ and where the ETF-era regime shift is doing the real damage.

still_missing.name: Quantum-Computing / Cryptographic-Obsolescence Existential-Hazard Discount
still_missing.why: DISTINCT mechanism, not a restatement of the field's abstract 'Survival/Ruin-Probability (Absorbing-Zero Hazard).' The generic ruin model treats failure as a featureless Poisson absorbing-zero event; the quantum/protocol-obsolescence channel is a SPECIFIC, partially-datable technological-displacement risk that loads on EXACTLY the 10-15yr CMA window. A cryptographically-relevant quantum computer (CRQC) is variously dated ~2028-2033 (the 'Quantum Doomsday Clock' ~Mar-2028; Bernstein 'real but manageable'), with ~6.9M BTC of exposed/reused public keys at risk (CoinDesk, Apr-2026; HRF) and Bitcoin lacking a coordinated post-quantum migration roadmap unlike Ethereum. For a decade-plus CMA this is the dominant left-tail term and a structural haircut to the discount rate: P(successful migration before CRQC) x conditional value + P(failure) x ~0. It also subsumes broader protocol-displacement risk (a technically-superior successor money) that NO current approach prices. Primary anchors: CoinDesk quantum-threat coverage (2026); Bernstein note (Apr-2026); Aggarwal et al. 'Quantum attacks on Bitcoin' (Ledger/PMC). Net CMA effect: lowers expected appreciation a few %/yr and fattens the absorbing-zero tail specifically in the 2028-2040 horizon.

still_missing.name: Cost-to-Attack / 'Economic Limits' Security-Floor Lower Bound (Budish)
still_missing.why: DISTINCT from both 'Equilibrium/Game-Theoretic Security-Utility Pricing' (endogenous price-security fixed point) and 'Mining-Economics Security-Budget Sustainability' (whether the fee budget SUSTAINS security). This inverts the logic into a VALUATION FLOOR / no-double-spend incentive-compatibility bound: the network is only safe if the value extractable from a 51%/double-spend attack stays below the flow + stock cost of acquiring majority hashpower (~$10B hardware + energy in 2026 at ~950-990 EH/s). Eric Budish, 'The Economic Limits of Bitcoin and the Blockchain' (BFI/NBER) formalizes this as a hard collateral constraint linking transaction value, mining reward flow, and attack cost - implying a CEILING on safely-settleable value per block and a security-driven FLOOR on market cap. Distinct mechanism (security economics as a lower bound), distinct CMA implication (caps the credible 'settlement-network' utility term and ties long-run value to a declining post-subsidy fee budget). Not currently represented as a floor anywhere in the field.

still_missing.name: Lost-Coin / Effective-Supply Attrition (Stochastic Deflationary Scarcity)
still_missing.why: DISTINCT supply-side mechanism the field omits: every existing supply approach (S2F, 'Structural Stock-Flow Demand-Clearing,' 'ETF-AUM Inelastic-Markets Multiplier') models ISSUANCE only - none model supply DECAY. Coins are permanently lost/dormant at ~3.3%/yr (CoinLedger/Crowdfund Insider 2025; est. 2.3-3.7M BTC, ~11-18% of cap already gone), and 'ancient'-coin dormancy (~566 BTC/day) now exceeds miner issuance (~450 BTC/day) - so EFFECTIVE float shrinks, making BTC net-deflationary post-2028. This is a separate price multiplier acting on the inelastic-supply curve: a shrinking liquid float amplifies any demand shock beyond what the issuance-only models assume. CMA relevance: a modest structural tailwind to appreciation and a higher demand-to-price elasticity, but with deep measurement uncertainty (lost is unobservable, and re-animation of 'lost' coins is a tail risk). Worth one approach because it changes the denominator the whole field divides market cap by.

still_missing.name: Realized-Inflation / Fisher-Hedge Passthrough (CPI-Conditioned, Regime-Contingent)
still_missing.why: Partially overlaps the 'Monetary-Substitution / M2 Elasticity & Debasement Hedge' family but tests a DIFFERENT object: not money-SUPPLY growth, but whether BTC actually compensates REALIZED CPI inflation (the Fisher relation), which is the mechanism that should drive the BTC-TIPS correlation cell and the real-return CMA. The empirical literature is specifically informative and largely NEGATIVE: the Fisher/hedge property holds short-run but FAILS long-run, is CPI-specific (not PCE), concentrated in high-inflation/bull regimes, and present mainly PRE-institutionalization (Choi & Shin / MPRA 120477; ScienceDirect 2024). For a 10-15yr CMA this directly disciplines the TIPS and real-appreciation cells: BTC is at best a weak, regime-contingent inflation hedge, not a reliable one - a finding none of the supply/M2 approaches deliver because they test trend money, not realized inflation passthrough.

still_missing.name: ESG / Carbon-Footprint Institutional-Exclusion Demand-Suppression Channel
still_missing.why: A distinct DEMAND-SIDE suppressor not captured by 'Official-Sector Policy-Endogenous Return Caps' (which is ban/repression/regulatory-capital) or 'Mining-Economics' (which is the supply/security side). Mechanism: ESG mandates, net-zero commitments, and carbon-disclosure rules structurally EXCLUDE proof-of-work BTC from a large pool of institutional capital regardless of return, shrinking the realizable TAM that every adoption/SoV approach assumes is fully addressable. Bitcoin energy use ~near all-time-high (Digiconomist; S&P Global Dec-2024; Cambridge CCAF), and the carbon-footprint trajectory (arXiv 2011.02612) keeps the issue live. CMA relevance: a haircut on the institutional-adoption term and a source of regime risk if carbon regulation tightens; weakest of the five and arguably a sub-case of policy caps, included only to round out the demand-suppression side the field under-weights.

breadth_assessment: The field is now extraordinarily comprehensive - effectively exhaustive of the legitimate, decision-relevant mechanism space for a 10-15yr Bitcoin CMA. Across the ~73 listed approaches every major valuation 'engine' is represented: supply-scarcity (S2F, structural stock-flow, inelastic-markets), network-value (Metcalfe/NVT/Burniske/generalized-Metcalfe-logistic), cost/energy (production floor, thermoeconomic, security-budget), monetary/macro (M2 elasticity, QTM, Cagan/Jermann, FTPL, Triffin/dedollarization, eurodollar, hyperbitcoinization, debasement-CAGR), store-of-value TAM and cross-asset relative value, the full stochastic-process and tail toolkit (regime-switch/jump, rough vol, fractal/Hurst/ARFIMA, EVT/GPD, LPPLS, survival/ruin), the complete derivatives/risk-premium layer (RND/vol-surface, VRP/SVCJ, skew, perp-funding/carry, convenience-yield), equilibrium asset-pricing (consumption-CAPM/rare-disaster/ICAPM, rational-bubble OLG, game-theoretic security, Black-Litterman/implied-equilibrium inversion), the behavioral/narrative cluster, the modern demand-microstructure channels (ETF cointegration, discrete-access step-function, treasury-company flywheel, stablecoin float, square-root impact, on-chain flow), the ML/empirical-asset-pricing and nowcasting block, and the portfolio-construction/CMA-assembly machinery (LTCMA, LDI, entropy-pooling, CVaR, DCC-copula). Crucially, the framing already enforces the right discipline - extrapolating BTC's appreciation DECAY (142->65->17%/yr) rather than its level, and treating the academically-rejected hype models (naive S2F/Metcalfe/gold-parity, power-law) as cautionary rather than load-bearing. The five gaps I name are genuine DISTINCT mechanisms but second-order: a quantum/protocol-obsolescence existential hazard that uniquely loads the 2028-2040 left tail (the single most defensible addition); a Budish cost-to-attack security FLOOR (vs the field's security-as-cost/sustainability framings); a lost-coin EFFECTIVE-supply-attrition deflationary multiplier (the field models issuance but never supply decay); a realized-CPI Fisher-hedge test that specifically disciplines the TIPS/real-return cells; and an ESG-exclusion demand-suppression channel. None of these would materially move the honest cross-approach central estimate (~8-12% nominal / ~5-9% real, vol ~50-60%, gold corr ~0-0.15) - the quantum and Budish-floor items mainly widen and lower the tail, the lost-coin item is a modest upside tailwind, and the Fisher/ESG items reinforce the 'weak inflation hedge, regime-contingent institutional bid' read already embedded. Recommendation: add the quantum-obsolescence hazard and the Budish security-floor as full approaches (they carry distinct, citable academic/practitioner literature and change the tail), fold lost-coin attrition into the supply/inelastic-markets family as a sensitivity, and treat the Fisher-hedge and ESG items as refinements of the debasement and policy-cap approaches rather than standalone additions. With those, the field can be declared closed for a credible decade-plus BTC CMA."
